title: 3 A.M.
desc: Sunny, Raj and Cyrus attempt a ghost-hunting reality show at a haunted site, but their plan spirals into terror as real supernatural forces strike, leading to deadly consequences.

title: Muqabla (1993)
desc: Two brother police officers, Suraj and Deepak, clash when Deepak sides with a suspect arrested by Suraj. A widow seeks justice for her husband's murder in this tense tale.

title: Judaai
desc: Driven by greed, Kajal urges her honest husband Raj to marry his boss's wealthy daughter Janhvi, but her plan triggers unforeseen consequences that threaten their lives.

title: The Hero: Love Story Of A Spy
desc: Arun, an Indian spy, falls for Reshma. When she disappears during a mission, he vows revenge and sets out to punish those responsible.

title: Bharat
desc: During the India-Pakistan partition, Bharat is separated from his family and left to care for those who remain. He spends his life trying to uphold the promise he made to his father.

title: Sam Bahadur
desc: Sam Manekshaw, one of India's most decorated army officers, served for over four decades, fought five wars, and became the first Indian officer to be promoted to Field Marshal.

title: Parmanu: The Story Of Pokhran
desc: Ashwat, an IAS officer, secretly leads a nuclear project. But he must hide everything from American intelligence to make the mission successful and safe.

title: Hogi Pyaar Ki Jeet
desc: Two brothers reunite to avenge their father's humiliation and murder by Thakur, plotting to marry his daughters as part of a calculated plan to settle scores.

title: Sab Moh Maaya Hai
desc: Ramnaresh, a poor peon nearing retirement, faces conflict with his son Piyush, who blames reservations for his joblessness. But Piyush later realizes his father's love and sacrifices.

title: Shirdi Ke Sai Baba
desc: A doctor visits Shirdi with his ailing son, torn between faith and science. To save his child, he must decide if Sai Baba's blessings hold the cure he desperately seeks.

title: Mr. India
desc: Arun shelters a group of orphans and is harassed by a gangster eyeing his house. After a child dies, he uses his father's invisibility watch to fight back.

title: Chori Chori Chupke Chupke
desc: Raj and Priya hire Madhubala as a surrogate. But when Madhubala falls for Raj and claims the child as her own, love, betrayal, and chaos turn their lives upside down.

title: Desh Premee
desc: Master Dinanath, a freedom fighter, flees his village with his son Raju and finds refuge with four crooks. Unaware of their deceit, he strives to reform and unite them.

title: Gadar 2
desc: Tara Singh goes missing during a skirmish and is believed captured in Pakistan. His son Jeete sets out to rescue him, plunging them into a deadly maze they must escape at all costs.

title: Indian
desc: Policeman Raj arrests terrorist Wasim Khan and earns praise, but when his father-in-law is mysteriously murdered, Raj is framed and must prove his innocence.

title: Khamoshi
desc: Annie, daughter of a hearing and speech-impaired couple, falls for Raj who brings music and love into her life. She faces challenges when her family rejects their relationship.
